variants.headline: Illness spreads beyond the clinics' reach
variants.body: Illness is spreading, with {sick} people too ill to work and {district} worst affected. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Pandemic leaves {sick} too ill to work
variants.body: The pandemic has left {sick} people unable to work; {district} is the worst affected district. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: {district} bears the worst of the pandemic
variants.body: The worst affected district is {district}, while illness leaves {sick} people unable to work. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
